subject: general
question: Which of the following replaced the Planning Commission of India?

options.text: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices

solution:
The correct answer is** NITI Ayoyog**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The** NITI Aayog serves as the apex public policy **think tank of the Government of India.
 
• The nodal agency tasked with catalyzing economic development, and fostering cooperative federalism through the involvement of State Governments of India in the economic policy-making process using a bottom-up approach
